n06.rewritten_query: DPR ColBERT positive negative training examples negative sampling contrastive loss training objective
n06.hypothetical_document: DPR and ColBERT construct positive training examples from relevant query-document pairs and negative examples from non-relevant or hard-negative passages. They optimize contrastive or ranking losses that push positive pairs closer while separating negatives in the representation space.
